brief: The viewer sees a dynamic, cutaway cross-section of a running combustion engine. Within the central cylinders, pistons rise and fall within their bores, connecting through visibly rotating rods to a central crankshaft. The key action is the precise, cyclical actuation and timing of the intake and exhaust valves, which open and close in synchronization with the pistons’ movement. Colored fluids flow through the open valves, illustrating the intake and exhaust cycles, demonstrating the continuous, automatic process of power generation.

statement: This sketch presents a dynamic, cutaway view of a two-cylinder combustion engine running in real-time. Using the WEBGL renderer, it visualizes the core mechanics: pistons moving up and down within their cylinders, connected to a rotating crankshaft through connecting rods. The engine's timing is illustrated by synchronized intake and exhaust valves that open and close as pistons move, with colored fluid flows showing the direction of air/fuel mixture and exhaust gases. The motion is entirely self-contained, driven by mathematical calculations without any user input or external triggers. The visualization emphasizes the cyclical nature of engine operation through continuous animation and precise mechanical relationships.
